# Camsur AI Studio

> Open-source AI photo studio: a Flutter mobile app and a FastAPI + Supabase backend that turn selfies into studio-quality photos (AI headshots, LinkedIn photos, passport photos, background edits) using FLUX image models. MIT licensed monorepo.

Camsur AI Studio has two parts in one repository: `camsur-flutter` (mobile app, Dart/Flutter, GetX, Dio) and `camsur-backend` (Python 3.12, FastAPI, Supabase auth/database/storage, Black Forest Labs FLUX). It includes a credit-based wallet with atomic, idempotent spend/refund, automatic refunds on failed generations, rate limits, cost controls, a margin monitor, an admin API and storage retention cleanup.

- [Generation lifecycle](camsur-backend/docs/GENERATION_LIFECYCLE.md): statuses and failure handling
- [Cost controls](camsur-backend/docs/COST_CONTROLS.md): limits, kill switch, margin circuit breaker
- [Storage lifecycle](camsur-backend/docs/STORAGE_LIFECYCLE.md): uploads, outputs, retention
